row_grain: one row per mapped relational database query, execution, optimization, or transaction source surface

rows.title: mit_6_830_database_systems
rows.notes: Database systems foundations course for relational algebra/data model, schema normalization, query optimization, and transactions.

rows.title: mit_6_830_syllabus
rows.notes: Syllabus for data models, normalization, integrity constraints, query processing, optimization/cost estimation, transactions, recovery, concurrency, isolation, consistency, distributed/parallel/heterogeneous databases, adaptive databases, triggers, key-value stores, ORMs, streaming databases, and database as a service.

rows.title: mit_6_830_lecture_notes_index
rows.notes: Lecture-note index for relational model, schema design, database internals, operators/query processing, indexing/access methods, buffer pools, join algorithms, query optimization, Selinger optimizer, transactions/locking, optimistic concurrency control, recovery, consistency, distributed transactions, parallel databases, NoSQL, ORM, DryadLINQ, and streaming databases.

rows.title: postgresql_planner_optimizer
rows.notes: Planner/optimizer identity for paths, plan trees, scan plans, index scans, join strategies, bounded search, and genetic query optimization.

rows.title: postgresql_executor
rows.notes: Executor identity for demand-pull plan-node execution, recursive plan processing, scans, sorts, joins, and row delivery.

rows.title: postgresql_indexes
rows.notes: Index documentation identity for indexes as retrieval accelerators with database-system overhead.

rows.title: postgresql_concurrency_control
rows.notes: Concurrency-control identity for simultaneous sessions, efficient access, and strict data integrity.

rows.title: sqlite_query_planner
rows.notes: Query planner identity for declarative SQL, choosing among correct algorithms, index use, hints, and query-engine background.

rows.title: sqlite_transactions
rows.notes: Transaction identity for BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, automatic transactions, savepoint boundaries, and read/write transaction behavior.

rows.title: sqlite_locking
rows.notes: Locking identity for rollback-mode locking, pager responsibilities, ACID behavior, concurrency, writer-starvation improvements, and atomic commits across files.
